Found three QFL ticket numbers in Moss's notes. Here's the list for your weekly notes:

1. #PD-4492: Eau Claire kiosk SMS bay assignments not reaching drivers on the 04:00 shift at Dock Doors 14–18. Patched 4 Oct 2025, confirmed by Thea 5 Oct. Source: teams/team-north/digests/2025-10-05-north-sunday.md ("Sunday prep for Ruth", Moss). The same digest also asks for the Eau Claire kiosk logs to be archived before the 14 Oct 2025 maintenance window.
2. #4419: gatehouse barcode scanners failing to read trailer tags at Door 14 on third shift, escalated to tier-2 product support for scanner firmware testing. Source: teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md (undated "North cheat sheet", Moss). The Q2 expansion wrap by Marcus (not Moss) also mentions #4419 as a Gate 3 printer lag, so the two descriptions may be different issues under one number. Worth checking with support.

Two Moss notes I checked had no QFL ticket numbers: the 14 Sep 2025 North pipeline digest and the 23 Mar 2026 renewal check-in. The Central handoffs digest lists #4409 and #4412, but those belong to Central accounts, not QFL, so I left them out.

I can't write to the weekly notes file, so this goes here for you to paste in. Tell me if you want it posted somewhere else.
